tasks.title: Safe speed
tasks.statement: Deceleration **{a} m/s²**, reliable sensor range **{d} m**, margin **{m} m**, reaction delay **{t} s**. Find the maximum speed (m/s) at which the vehicle stops before the margin: v·t + v²/(2a) = d − m.
tasks.solution: The quadratic v²/(2a) + v·t − (d − m) = 0 → v = a·(−t + √(t² + 2(d − m)/a)).

tasks.title: Octile distance
tasks.statement: An 8-connected grid. From cell (0, 0) to (**{dx}**, **{dy}**) with no obstacles. What is the length of the shortest path in cells?
tasks.solution: min(dx,dy) diagonal steps of √2 each and |dx − dy| straight ones.

tasks.title: Dijkstra path around a square zone
tasks.statement: A straight line of **{L} m** from start to goal passes through the center of a square exclusion zone with a side of **{a} m**; the zone center is at the middle of the line. `OA_MARGIN_MAX` = **{M} m**. Dijkstra moves each vertex of the zone out along the bisector by M and flies start → the two moved vertices of the near side → goal. Find the path length (m).
tasks.solution: Offset along each axis d = M/√2. The path corners: (L/2 − a/2 − d, a/2 + d) and (L/2 + a/2 + d, a/2 + d). Length = 2·√((L/2 − a/2 − d)² + (a/2 + d)²) + (a + 2d). For L = 80, a = 20, M = 5: 29.72 + 27.07 + 29.72 = 86.5 m (SITL: 87.0 m).

tasks.title: Occupancy probability after k hits
tasks.statement: A grid cell starts at p = 0.5 (L = 0). The sensor model: a beam hit has p_hit = **{ph}**. The beam hit the cell **{k}** times in a row. The module's clamp L = ±3.5 is not reached with these values (k·ln(p_hit/(1 − p_hit)) ≤ 3.39). What is the occupancy probability?
tasks.solution: L = k·ln(p_hit/(1 − p_hit)), p = 1 − 1/(1 + e^L). For p_hit = 0.7 and k = 3: L = 2.542, p = 0.927, as in step 2.
